selection_evidence: Qwen JSON V2 is the most faithful of the three general models on this fixed screen (22/24 versus 21 Gemma and 18 Ministral), but both Qwen/Gemma have 18/24 fully acceptable outputs and each makes 7 useful faithful edits of 11 needing cleanup. Gemma removes an extra filler but corrupts a plain Windows path; Qwen misses filler and preserves that path. Ministral is more aggressive but loses emphasis/nuance, adds markup and corrupts literals. Qwen is a provisional quality finalist; these small synthetic differences do not establish a universal model-quality ranking.
